1465.name: Peschisolido
pages:
* Signed for Fulham during the 97-98 season. 
* During his second spell at Birmingham City, the club who originally brought him over from Canadian football, and the club where his wife Karren Brady works, Paul Peschisolido once again found himself out of the side and moving on to West Bromwich Albion. With the Baggies he has shown himself to be a clever, skillful player who has an eye for a goalscoring opportunity.
* A regular member of the Canadian national squad, Peschisolido also made himself a regular at West Bromwich, first of all under Alan Buckley and later under Ray Harford, and proved himself to be the best striking partner for Andy Hunt. Both players formed a fearsome partnership and once again, great things will be expected this time out.

* Peschisolido is a striker who makes up for his lack of power with his astute approach to the game. With the ball apparently tied to his feet, he is very difficult to dispossess. Quick and decisive he is a good finisher. He has good dribbling skills and is capable of going off on an individual run, and, with his ability to beat a man, very often ends them with a goal. He is good in the air, not due to his ability to get up above defenders but as a result of his opportunism and positional sense. Defensively he makes only a very limited contribution. He has good vision and is a reasonable passer of the ball. He is basically a right footed player although he can use his left when he needs to.

* Top scorer at Birmingham City in the 92-93 season together with Andy Saville. 
* Top scorer at Stoke City in the 94-95 season. 
* Named Player of the Year in the Major Indoor Soccer League.
* 20 full international appearances for Canada.

* Birmingham City signed him from Canadian club Toronto Blizzards in November 1992 for £25,000. He made his league debut on 21st November 1992 against Barnsley, and scored his first goal in English football on 19th December 1992 against Watford. 
* He was transfered to Stoke City in August 1994 for £400,000 plus Dave Regis who moved in the opposite direction to Birmingham City. He made His league debut for the Potters on 13th August 1994 against Tranmere Rovers. His first goal for the club proved to be the winner against Charlton Athletic on 14th September 1894. 
* He returned to Birmingham City for £400,000 in February 1996. His first game in his second spell with the Blues came on 30th March 1996 against Grimsby Town and he struck his first goal on 6th April 1996 against Port Vale.
* The Canadian striker signed for WBA in the summer 1996 for £550,000. His debut for the Baggies came on 7th September against QPR, a game in which he also scored his first goal for his new club.

* A magnificent season for Paul Peschisolido, who, together with Hunt and Taylor, formed a tremendously effective forward line for WBA. However the Canadian striker generally lined up alongside Hunt, to some extent keeping Taylor in the shadows. He managed to score 15 goals in 37 games for the Baggies and, if it hadn't been for his call ups to the Canadian squad, he would no doubt have found the back of the net on more occasions.

1467.name: Moody
pages: * Paul Moody is a typical centre forward, excellent in the air, but not so comfortable with the ball at his feet though that has never hindered his tremendous ability to find the back of the net. A team man, he is tireless in his support for his teammates, while his excellent form in previous years has made him an automatic first team choice. He has responded to the faith shown in him in the best way possible by scoring goals and making himself Oxford United's top scorer for the last three seasons.

* Paul Moody is a typical centre forward whose main weapon in his ability in the air taking advantage of his height and his impressive physical power. Though not particularly skillful with the ball at his feet this has never stopped him from getting in shots on goal with either foot, demonstrating a tremendous goalscoring instinct. Moody takes full advantage of his physique coming out on top in physical challenges with defenders. He's willing to have a go at goal when given even the slightest opportunity. Keeps defenders under constant pressure and drops back to help out the defence at corners and free kicks.
* Top goalscorer at Oxford United during the seasons, 93-94, 94-95 and 95-96.
x

* Southampton signed him from amateur club Waterlooville in July 1991 for £50,000. He made his league debut on 17th August 1991 against Tottenham Hotspur.
* He was loaned out to Reading during that same month while his first goal came on 19th December 1992 against Stockport County. 
* In February 1994 he was transfered to  Oxford United for £60,000. He made his debut on 25th February 1994 against Peterborough United while he scored his first goal for the club.

* Last season Paul Moody made a total of 38 appearances for Oxford United, finding the back of the net four times. In terms of goalscoring, he wasn't up to the expected standard, something maybe influenced by the niggling injuries - though nothing serious - which he suffered during the course of the season.

1488.name: Gayle
pages: * John Gayle is a centre forward who was little used at Stoke City, nor for that matter in his previous teams. He is not a man who has an amazing technical level but he literally sweats blood on the pitch for his team, helping his team-mates as much as possible. He wasn't a man who Lou Macari used often, except in the case of injuries or suspensions.

* Gayle is a very strong centre forward but he is not a good finisher although his presence helps other forwards by drawing the attention of the defenders. He is not at all quick and moves laboriously. Also, he is technically discrete although he tries to make up for this with enthusiasm and team spirit. His height allows him to dominate in the air, more for his bulk than for his jump, making use of his weight and flattening defenders. In the area, if he receives the ball, he tries to shield it and pass or look for the shot without thinking twice.
* AMC Champion in 1991.
x

* Originally from the amateur club of Burton Albion, he signs as a professional for Wimbledon in February 1989.  He makes his league debut on  29th April 1989 against Newcastle United and scores his first goal as a professional against Charlton Athletic on the 26th December 1989.
* He is transferred to Birmingham City in November 1990 for £175,000.  He makes his league debut on the 24th November 1990 against Bournemouth and scores his first goals for the club on 1st January 1991 against Mansfield Town. 
* He is loaned to Walsall in August 1993, scoring on his debut (21/8/93) against Shrewsbury Town.
* Coventry City sign him in August 1993 for £100,000 and he makes his debut on 25th March 1993 against Leeds United.
* He is transferred to Burnley in August 1994.  He plays his first game against Stoke City on the 20th September 1994 and scores his first goal on the 20th November 1994 against Sheffield United.
* Finally he signs for Stoke City in January 1995 for £70,000.  He makes his debut on 11th February 1995 against Sheffield United and scores his first goal for the Potters against Luton Town on the 4th November 1995.
* He is loaned to Gillingham in March 1996 until the end of the season. He scores on his debut in a game against Mansfield Town on the 16th  March 1996.

* He started the season at Stoke City, played 12 games and scored one goal. In February 1997 he was transferred to Northampton where he finished the season. With his new team he alternated between playing in the first team and sitting on the substitutes' bench, playing a total of 13 gamesl.

1505.name: Barlow
pages:
* Signed for Wigan Athletic in March 1998. 
* After 6 years at Everton, Stuart Barlow, wasn't getting the opportunities he would had wanted, making only sporadic appearances in the side, although he did manage to put together a few spells as a member of the starting line up. Nevertheless, for the different managers who have passed through Goodison Park in recent years, men such as Tony Cottee and Duncan Ferguson took priority over Stuart Barlow. 
* Now, at Wigan Athletic, he is hoping to relaunch a career which, to some extent, has lost a sense of direction following his years with the Merseyside club, and has failed to live up to the expectations that many had.

* A centre forward, his main assets are his speed and power, qualities which allow him ro make dangerous runs into the opposition's penalty area from deep positions. He also has good dribbling ability and vision. However, he is not an outstanding goalscorer - a player who is as capable of scoring incredible goals as he is of missing clear cut opportunities. He scores a good number of goals with his head for such as relatively short player. When the ball is played into the area he seems to have a sixth sense which gets him in the right place at the right time. He works hard to keep the opposing defence under constant pressure. Although Barlow has the ability to create space for himself, he doesn't take as much advantage of this as he should, something which is reflected in his goalscoring record. Though good with either foot, his right is the stronger of the two.
* F.A. Cup winners medal 94-95.
x

* Stuart Barlow signed for Everton on 6th June 1990 from Liverpool amateur league side Sherwood Park. He made his league debut on 10th April 1991 in a game against Wimbledon at Goodison Park and scored twice in the league on 28th December 1992 against QPR.       * He was transfered to Oldham Athletic in November 1995 for £350,000. pages: * Neil Lewis is one of the most talented players to have come out of the youth squad at Filbert Street in recent years.  However, despite being in the first squad for four seasons he still hasn't managed to find a regular place in the starting line-up.  The appointment of Martin O'Neill as manager at Leicester half-way through the season before last was a morale-booster for the young Lewis, who saw how the trainer had some faith in him and aligned him from several consecutive games.  The young player had some brilliant matches.  His speed and spectacular turn made him one of the crowd's favourites.  The young 23 year-old footballer now has to try and build on this and convert his promise into a reality.

* He usually plays up front on the left, although his characteristics allow him to adapt to the position of wing back.  Very left-footed, you rarely see him play the ball with his right foot, but this doesn't prevent him from going past his opponents with apparent ease to get to the by-line in order to put over a cross to the box.  Neil Lewis could become a great footballer, although he should work hard on improving his finishing - he hardly scores any goals - and his ball control with the right.

1695.name: Gregory
pages:
* He was transfered to Colchester United in March 1998 for 50.000 pounds. 
* The young Ipswich Town striker hasn't got an easy job on his hands as he attempts to force his way into the side on a regular basis. George Burley seems to show a clear preference for Scowcroft although Gregory is the more technically gifted of the two and shows more natural instinct in the penalty area. Although he has been a regular scorer in the reserve side he only managed to show just what he can do on one occasion last season, when he managed to hit a hat-trick. Gregory faces up to the new season with renewed confidence although, of course, things are going to be far from easy for him.

* A centre forward of great mobility, he is a very uncomfortable opponent for defenders to look after. Though stronger on his right than on his left, when he goes for goal he is happy to use either. A very clever player inside the area, he is always looking for spaces,and will have a go at goal when given the slightest opportunity to do so.
x
x

* A product of Ipswich Town system he signed as a professional in March 1992 and made his league debut on 16th December 1994 against Wimbledon. He struck his first two goals on 16th September 1995 against Watford.
* He was sent out on loan to Chesterfield in February 1994, scoring on his league debut against Chester City on 19th February 1994.
* He had another loan spell at Scunthorpe United in March 1995, staying at the club until the end of the season. He league debut for the club couldn't have been better, as he managed to strike twice against Bury on 11th March.
* On one occasion Gregory had to go in goal against Charlton Athletic in place of Ipswich Town keeper Craig Forrest, who went of injured, while there was no goalkeeping lover on the bench. Unfortunately, Gregory let in 4 goals. 
* He went out on loan once again, this time to Torquay United in November 1996, making his first appearance for the South coast club on 23rd of that same month, against Hartlepool United.

* Despite the deaprture of Marshall, and Alex Mathie's long time out due to injury,  Gregory was unable to make the position his own, and could only watch, unable to do anything as the opportunities passed him by. Following his spell out on loan to Torquay United, his good performances in the reserve side saw him finally given a chance in the first team. He didn't  waste his chance and managed to stay in the side until the end of the season, including the crucial promotion play offs.

1891.name: Snodin
pages: * Ian Snodin is a footballer whose career has been hindered by injuries, and so he hasn't reached the level he promised. However, he is still a man with a strong competitive spirit and was a true leader for the youngsters of Oldham Athletic. Now at Scarborough he hopes to play more frequently.

* Although Ian Snodin's natural position is that of right back, in emergencies he can play both as a central defender and as a midfielder although he is more comfortable as a wide defender. He goes in very hard for the ball. He is basically a defensive player, though Snodin will join in the attack when he has the chance, but he doesn't lose his ahead about it. He is a secure passer, both over short and long range and has a good shot with his right. He is not very quick but makes up for this with good positioning.
* League Champion with Everton in the 86-87 season.
* Snodin has been an England international in the youth, B and under-21 categories, making his debut in the latter of these on 13th November 1984 against Turkey.

* Trained in the lower ranks of Doncaster Rovers, he signs as a professional in August 1980.  He makes his league debut on 29th MArch 1980 against Bournemouth and his first goal in the league is on 19th April 1980 against Aldershot.
* In May 1985 he is transferred to Leeds United. He plays his first game against Fulham and scores his first goal against Stoke City.
* In January 1987 he is transferred to Everton for £750,000. He makes his debut on 17th January 1987 against Sheffield Wednesday and scores his first goal on 17th October 1987 against Newcastle United.
* In the 90-91 season he suffers from a serious injury which keeps him out for several months and once recovered, he doesn't figure in Howard Kendall's plans, only stepping onto the pitch in the 92-93 season, although always as a substitute.
* In October 1994 he is loaned to Sunderland, making his debut on 15th October 1994 against Burnley.
* His contract finishes and he signs for Oldham Athletic in January 1995. His first goal for the Latics is on 14th January 1995 against Sunderland.
* His season was reduced to just 14 games due to various injuries he suffered during the year.

1906.name: Laws
pages: * Laws is a quick aggressive right back or right half.  It is hard to come out on top in a collision with him.  A good marker and experienced, he is sure in his actions.  Despite being a veteran footballer, Laws shows that he can still play the short game well and his passing hasn't got any worse. His forays up-field also cause a certain amount of danger.

* Third Division Champion with Burnley. 
* League Cup Champion with Nottingham Forest in 1989 and 90 beating Luton Town and Oldham Athletic respectively. 
* Runner-up in the League Cup in 1992 with Nottingham Forest, after losing to Manchester United. 
* FA Cup runner-up with Nottingham Forest in 1991, losing in the final to Tottenham Hotspur.
* He has been an England B international.

* Originally from the lower ranks of Burnley, he signs as a professional on the 1st of October 1979.  He makes his league debut on the 3/5/80 against Watford and scores his first goal as a professional on the 4/10/80 against Fulham. 
* Transferred to Huddersfield Town in August 1983 for £10,000.  He plays his first game on the 3/9/83 against Charlton Athletic and scores his first goal against Middlesbrough on the 3/11/84. 
* Middlesbrough sign him for £30,000 in March 1985.  His debut takes place on the 16/3/85 against Sheffield United and he scores his first goal on the 11/5/85 against Shrewsbury Town. 
* Transferred to Nottingham Forest in July 1988 for £120,000, he plays his first game on the 12/11/88 against West Ham United.  He scores his first goal for his team on the 21/1/89 against Aston Villa.  In the 93-94 season, and after many years in the starting line-up, Frank Clark signs Des Lyttle and Laws is relegated to the substitutes' bench. 
* His contract expires and he signs for Grimsby in November 1994, and is also nominated player-manager of the club.  His debut with the Mariners is on the 28/1/95 against Notts County and his first goal, on the 1/4/95 against Port Vale, is his team's winner. 
* His role as manager is cut short in the last few days of October 1996 due to his team's bad run of results.

* He started last season as the player-manager at Grimsby Town, but was quickly relieved of the managerial role.  Darlington was his next destination, but in January 1997 he signed for Scunthorpe United, where he also took on the job of coach.

pages: * Su gran temporada en el Mallorca le ha permitido volver al Oviedo, donde deberá trabajar duro para hacerse con un puesto de titular, aunque la llegada de un nuevo técnico, Juan Manuel Lillo, le permitirá afrontar el campeonato en igualdad de condiciones que sus compañeros. En el conjunto balear gozó de la continuidad que le había faltado durante su estancia en Primera División y demostró que estaba totalmente capacitado para militar en la máxima categoría del fútbol español.

* Juega como extremo a la vieja usanza, muy abierto a la banda, preferentemente la derecha, y siempre con la vista puesta en el área contraria. Es rapidísimo, muy hábil en carrera con el balón controlado y tremendamente vertical. Una de sus mejores virtudes es su capacidad para desequilibrar en el uno contra uno, gracias a su velocidad y a su buena cintura.
X
X

* Debutó en Primera División con el Barcelona en la temporada 92-93. 
* Ha disputado 43 encuentros en la máxima categoría. 
* Tiene contrato hasta el 30 de junio de 1997.

* La pasada campaña disputó 30 partidos con el Mallorca, 20 de ellos como titular, marcó diez goles, le mostraron tres tarjetas amarillas y fue expulsado una vez. Fue una de las claves de la sensacional temporada del equipo balear y junto con Morales formó una de las mejores delanteras de Segunda División.

9485.name: Julio Salinas
pages: * Julio Salinas sólo ha necesitado que le dieran continuidad durante una temporada para demostrar que continúa siendo uno de los delanteros más efectivos del fútbol español. Condenado al ostracismo en sus últimos años en el Barcelona y en el Deportivo, ha sabido aprovechar la oportunidad brindada por el Sporting para volver a los primeros puestos del trofeo "Pichichi". Tiene la titularidad prácticamente asegurada y volverá a ser una de las claves para que el conjunto gijonés se mantenga sin problemas en Primera División.

* En apariencia patoso y con poca pinta de futbolista, tiene una rara e inexplicable habilidad para marcar goles. Es un oportunista consumado y siempre aparece en los momentos más necesarios para empujar los balones a la red. Capaz de conseguir goles inverosímiles, también ha fallado los tantos aparentemente más fáciles. No es rápido, no tiene un gran dominio del balón, tampoco destaca por ser un gran rematador de cabeza, ni por sus excelentes disparos a portería. Sin embargo, posee una cualidad innata que le convierte en letal dentro del área. Puede entusiasmar con sus goles o desesperar con sus fallos, pero nunca deja indiferente. Es un jugador muy regular y tremendamente rentable. Su figura desgarbada de espaldas a la portería, protegiendo el balón (lo hace como nadie), revolviéndose sin saber cómo y consiguiendo un gol impensable es una imagen repetida una y mil veces en los últimos años.

* Dos Ligas con el Athletic (83 y 84).

* Máximo goleador de Segunda División en 1984. 
* Cuatro Ligas con el Barcelona (91, 92, 93 y 94). 
* Una Copa de Europa con el Barcelona (92). 
* Una Recopa con el Barcelona (89). 
* Una Copa del Rey con Barcelona (90). 
* Una Supercopa de Europa con el Barcelona (93). 
* Dos Supercopas de España con el Barcelona (92 y 93).

* También vistió la camiseta de la selección sub-21 en 13 oportunidades.

* Es el único jugador, junto a Zubizarreta, que ha participado en tres Campeonatos del Mundo (México '86, Italia '90 y Estados Unidos '94). Además, ha conseguido goles en todos ellos. Marcó ante Irlanda del Norte en México, contra Yugoslavia en Italia y frente a Corea del Sur en Estados Unidos. 
* En el Mundial de Estados Unidos '94 jugó cuatro de los cinco partidos que la selección disputó allí. Sólo se perdió el de octavos de final ante Suiza. Disputó un total de 332 minutos y consiguió un gol.

* Lleva disputados 349 encuentros en Primera División y ha marcado 132 goles. 
* Es, con 22 tantos, el tercer máximo goleador de la Historia de la selección española. Por delante de él están Butragueño con 26 y Di Stéfano con 23.

* La pasada campaña disputó 38 encuentros (2.810 minutos), dio dos asistencias y marcó 18 goles. Fue uno de los mejores jugadores del Sporting y recuperó el olfato goleador, perdido en los últimos años. Su aportación resultó decisiva para que el conjunto gijonés se mantuviera en la categoría y demostró que es uno de los delanteros más efectivos del fútbol español.

9489.name: Rafa Paz
pages: * Rafa Paz es uno de los jugadores más carismáticos del Sevilla, todo un símbolo para la afición, que ve en él a un futbolista surgido de la cantera que se entrega al máximo por los colores del club. Titular casi indiscutible en los diez años que lleva en la primera plantilla, su concurso será importante, como lo fue la pasada campaña, para que el equipo afronte de la mejor forma posible la etapa de transición en la que se encuentra inmerso. Tiene grandes posibilidades de figurar en el once inicial.

* Puede jugar como lateral o interior, pero siempre por la banda derecha. Sacrificado y voluntarioso en defensa, sus continuos desdoblamientos por la banda han sido una de las mejores armas ofensivas del Sevilla en las últimas temporadas. Es un jugador con un amplio recorrido, al que tan pronto se le ve atacando en el área contraria como defendiendo en la propia. Combina sus excelentes condiciones físicas con una aceptable calidad técnica y visión de juego. A su entrega y profesionalidad, ha ido aportando una considerable dosis de experiencia, lo que le ha permitido obtener mayor rendimiento de sus facultades y disimular mejor sus defectos.
x

* Internacional absoluto 7 veces. 
* Ha sido internacional sub-21 en varias ocasiones. 
* Disputó el Mundial de Italia '90.

* Jugó su primer partido con el Sevilla el 9 de septiembre de 1984. 
* Debutó con España en 1990. 
* No ha vuelto a ser convocado por la selección desde que Luis Suárez dejara el cargo después del Mundial de Italia '90. 
* Lleva disputados 312 encuentros en Primera División. 
* Quiere ser entrenador cuando se retire.

* La temporada pasada disputó 31 encuentros (2.439 minutos), dio cuatro asistencias, marcó dos goles y le mostraron siete tarjetas amarillas. Su experiencia y categoría fue importante para que el Sevilla eludiera los puestos de promoción y consiguiera mantenerse en la categoría. Titular indiscutible durante todo el campeonato, sólo los problemas físicos y las tarjetas le alejaron del once inicial.

9490.name: Martín Vázquez
pages: * La primera temporada de Martín Vázquez en el Deportivo no ha podido ser más desafortunada, ya que a la decepcionante campaña del equipo se han unido sus continuos problemas físicos, que apenas le han permitido jugar. Completamente recuperado, es de esperar que en la campaña 96-97 Martín Vázquez se convierta en uno de los hombres clave del Deportivo y rinda al nivel que todos esperaban cuando recaló en el equipo. Una de las personas más interesadas en que el madrileño recupere su nivel es John Toshack, el hombre que recomendó su fichaje y que le considera básico para el buen funcionamiento del conjunto. No hay que olvidar que la mejor temporada en la carrera de Martín Vázquez fue bajo las órdenes del técnico galés en el Real Madrid.

* Es un jugador técnicamente casi perfecto y, probablemente, de los más elegantes que han pisado los campos españoles en los últimos años. Maneja con igual maestría las dos piernas y sus pases con el exterior del pie, aprendidos de su amigo Juanito, son recordados por los buenos seguidores que acudían al Santiago Bernabéu cuando Martín Vázquez vestía la camiseta del Real Madrid. Posee una excepcional visión de juego, un fenomenal disparo a puerta y tiene condiciones más que suficientes para asumir la dirección del equipo, aunque por diversos motivos no siempre ha sido capaz de erigirse en el punto de referencia para sus compañeros dentro del campo. Pese a las excepcionales cualidades que posee, y que llevaron a Menotti a declarar que con él hubiera sido el mejor futbolista del mundo, la irregularidad que le ha acompañado durante toda su trayectoria ha dejado en muchos aficionados la impresión de que no ha explotado al máximo sus facultades y que podía haber rendido mucho más de lo que lo ha hecho.

* Seis Ligas con el Real Madrid (86, 87, 88, 89, 90, 95). 
* Dos Copas del Rey con el Real Madrid (89 y 93). 
* Dos Supercopas con el Real Madrid (88 y 90). 
* Dos Copas de la UEFA con el Real Madrid. 
* Una Copa de la Liga con el Real Madrid. 
* Una Copa Iberia con el Real Madrid (94). 
* Una Liga de Segunda División con el Castilla. 
* Una Supercopa con el Deportivo (95). 
* Subcampeón de Europa sub-21 con España.

* Ha sido 38 veces internacional absoluto, 15 sub-21, 10 sub-18 y tres olímpico. 
* Estuvo presente en el Mundial de Italia '90.

* Fue en su día el jugador que más joven vistió la camiseta del Real Madrid en un partido de Liga, récord superado la temporada 94-95 por Raúl y Rivera. 
* Debutó el 4 de diciembre de 1983, ante el Real Murcia en el estadio de La Condomina. Ese día también debutó Sanchis. 
* Fue al componente de la "Quinta del Buitre" que más le costó llegar a la titularidad. 
* Se mantuvo siete años en el primer equipo del Real, desde 1983 hasta 1990, cuando una serie de problemas con el presidente del club, Ramón Mendoza, en las negociaciones para su renovación impulsaron a Martín Vázquez a aceptar una oferta del Torino. 
* En el Torino, un histórico de la Liga italiana recién asendido a la Serie A, militó dos temporadas y en ninguna de ellas rindió al nivel que esperaban los distintos estamentos del club. Bien es cierto que tuvo muchos problemas con su entrenador, Emiliano Mondonico, un técnico con una mentalidad ultradefensiva que se empeñó en cambiarle de posición una y otra vez, desaprovechando las cualidades del madrileño. 
* Con el Torino llegó a disputar la final de la Copa de la UEFA en 1992 ante el Ajax, que se impuso a los transalpinos por el valor doble de los tantos conseguidos en campo contrario. Previamente, el Torino había eliminado al Real Madrid en semifinales, enfrentamiento que deparó la primera y, hasta el momento, única visita de Martín Vázquez al estadio Santiago Bernabéu con una camiseta que no fuera la del club blanco. 
* Inició la temporada 92-93 en el Olympique de Marsella, club al que tampoco logró adaptarse. Contribuyó con dos goles a la victoria del OM ante el Glentoran en la primera ronda de la Copa de Europa. El conjunto marsellés terminó adjudicándose el torneo, por lo que se podría considerar a Martín Vázquez como campeón de Europa, algo que el futbolista rechaza. 
* En octubre de 1992, a pesar de haber declarado que jamás volvería al Real Madrid mientras Ramón Mendoza fuera el presidente, retornó al equipo madrileño. 
* Reapareció con el Real Madrid en Las Gaunas, contra el Logroñés, y marcó un gol que redondeó su buena actuación. 
* En el verano de 1995 decidió abandonar, esta vez quizá de forma definitiva, la entidad de Chamartín. Los problemas surgidos, nuevamente, con Ramón Mendoza en la negociación y las diferencias económicas entre las dos partes motivaron la salida del futbolista. 
* El club le propuso una considerable reducción de su ficha, lo que fue interpretado por Martín Vázquez como una invitación para que no siguiera en el equipo. Ante esto poco pudo hacer el entrenador, ya que aunque en la campaña 94-95 Rafa alternó la titularidad con suplencia, Jorge Valdano afirmó que contaba con él para la 95-96. 
* Sufrió la temida triada (rotura del menisco, del ligamento cruzado externo y del interno) el 2 de agosto de 1995, en el primer partido de la pretemporada pasada, frente al Oporto. Era su debut con el Deportivo y estuvo más de ocho meses de baja. Reapareció el 14 de abril de 1995, en el encuentro correspondiente a la 36ª jornada de Liga que enfrentó en Riazor a Deportivo y Mérida (2-1). 
* En la jornada 40 de la Liga 95-96 sufrió una rotura de fibras que le alejó de los terrenos de juego durante las últimas semanas del campeonato. 
* A lo largo de su carrera ha disputado 257 encuentros en Primera División.

* La temporada pasada actuó en cinco partidos (178 minutos). Las lesiones no le permitieron estar más tiempo sobre el terreno de juego, aunque en los escasos minutos que le utilizaron los técnicos dio muestras de su calidad, visión de juego y experiencia.

9494.name: Begiristain
pages: * Beguiristain inicia su segunda temporada en el Deportivo, donde llegó avalado por John Toshack, aunque ello no fue argumento suficiente para ganarse un puesto como titular. En la presente campaña tendrá que trabajar duro para hacerse con un sitio en el once inicial, algo especialmente complicado tras la recuperación de Martín Vázquez y el fichaje de Martins. Puede convertirse en el revulsivo al que recurra el técnico galés cuando las cosas no le vayan bien y quiera cambiar el ritmo de los encuentros.

* El paso del tiempo le ha restado velocidad a Beguiristain, pero le ha proporcionado madurez y sabiduría. Su juego ha experimentado una gran transformación en los últimos años. De aquel Txiki que desbordaba por la banda izquierda con regates vertiginosos se ha pasado a un futbolista menos veloz y más pausado, aunque no menos efectivo. Su pierna izquierda continúa siendo una de las mejores del fútbol español y ha suplido su pérdida de velocidad con más inteligencia, si cabe, sobre el terreno de juego. Ahora actúa más centrado que antes y se ha convertido en un maestro moviéndose entre líneas. Se desmarca con mucha facilidad, es vertical y sus pases al hueco son garantía de peligro. Aunque no es un gran rematador ni dispone de un disparo espectacular, tiene los recursos suficientes para convertir en gol un alto porcentaje de las ocasiones que se le presentan, ya que posee depuradísima técnica individual.

* Una Copa del Rey con la Real Sociedad (87). 
* Cuatro Ligas con el Barcelona (91, 92, 93 y 94). 
* Una Copa del Rey (90) con el Barcelona. 
* Tres Supercopas (91, 92 y 94) con el Barcelona. 
* Una Copa de Europa (92) con el Barcelona. 
* Una Recopa con el Barcelona (89). 
* Una Supercopa de Europa con el Barcelona (93).

* Ha sido 22 veces internacional absoluto. 
* Vistió en tres ocasiones la camiseta de la selección olímpica. 
* Debutó con la selección española absoluta en 1988. 
* En el Mundial de Estados Unidos '94 sólo jugó 29 minutos ante Suiza en el partido de octavos de final.

* El Barcelona pagó por él 300 millones de pesetas. 
* Cruyff dijo de él que era "el jugador más inteligente" que había tenido a sus órdenes. 
* Tiene contrato con el Deportivo hasta el 30 de junio de 1997. 
* Es el cuarto jugador en activo, tras Buyo, Zubizarreta y Bakero, que más partidos de Liga ha disputado: 443. 
* La presente es su decimocuarta temporada consecutiva en Primera División.

* La temporada pasada actuó en 33 partidos de Liga (1.630 minutos), dio dos asistencias, marcó otro tantos goles y le mostraron una tarjeta amarilla. Su rendimiento fue irregular y en pocas ocasiones fue el futbolista desequilibrante que esperaban los aficionados. Jugó con intermitencia y casi siempre que saltó al campo lo hizo para sustituir a un compañero. Prueba de ello es que disputó una media de 49 minutos por encuentro.
